ceiling_directive: Prove that DCTFTR failure is equivalent to nonidentification on the original broad district-closed model class, without focal saturation or BASep, and make the failure branch construct the promised pair of original-alphabet SCMs.
improvement_directive: Strengthen the sound-only recursion into a broad-class completeness theorem and extract two compatible canonical parameter points from the QE/CAD calculation, converting them into an explicit same-menu paired-SCM certificate. Replace the proof-tailored BASep-dependent converse or derive BASep from primitive graphical and menu conditions.
critique: The delivered local recursion is proved sound but not complete: FACE_NOT_IDENTIFIED certifies variation only in an outer row relaxation and need not imply broad-model nonidentification. Its converse requires focal-district saturation and BASep, a baseline-dependent condition tailored to make the lifting argument work and explicitly not checkable from menu cells alone. Broad completeness is recovered only by combining published finite canonicalization with generic real quantifier elimination, and that fallback returns range formulas and existentially guarantees two models rather than returning the explicit paired-model certificate requested by the headline. The TL;DR is mostly faithful to this weaker output, but calling the hybrid procedure a complete algorithm obscures that the novel graphical recursion itself has no failure-completeness theorem. The load-bearing quantifier-elimination lemma also lacks a usable bibliographic citation: the bibliography contains only the placeholder “BasuMohammadNezhad2024.”
